headline: A Turkish neighborhood is planned to be built in New Tashkent. President supports the project
summary: Turkey's Özgüven company plans to build a Turkish neighbourhood in the New Tashkent area. President Shavkat Mirziyoyev backed the initiative and ordered a roadmap to be prepared.
why: Large mixed-use real estate projects with foreign developers shape construction activity and foreign investment in urban areas. Özgüven is a Turkish company.
